label: Jared Evan Moskowitz
narrative: Moskowitz is the reason House UAP oversight is bipartisan rather than a Republican project, and he is the member who has most consistently framed it as a money question. At the July 2023 hearing he thanked Burchett and Luna for pushing the hearing into existence and read Chuck Schumer's language into the record: 'The American public has a right to learn about technologies of unknown origins, nonhuman intelligence, and unexplainable phenomena.' His questioning went straight at the financing - he asked Grusch directly whether US corporations are overcharging the government for technology and whether the excess is funding these programs, which is the black-budget mechanism the whole thesis rests on. In December 2023 he gave the cleanest statement of the House's structural complaint: 'The problem is when we ask those questions, rather than being provided information that would prove it false, they stonewall the information, and that is what piques the interest.' In November 2024 he served as Vice Ranking Member at the joint subcommittee hearing. At the 9 September 2025 Task Force hearing, waived on, he said the thing that has been quoted most since: 'I don't really know what is true, I don't know, on this subject, but I do know when we're being lied to and we are definitely being lied to, there's just no doubt about that.' He is a cosponsor of Burchett's H.R. 1187 UAP Transparency Act and appeared at the 9 June 2026 Capitol disclosure event - 'Disclosure today, disclosure tomorrow. The American people deserve to know.'
